routing.reason: Actual coverage concerns transactional integrity, tenant/actor proof enforcement and current authorization after serialization waits.

library_applicability.reason: Both utility dependencies are absent from package.json. The Playwright mandate also requires the Playwright runner; these existing suites use Vitest. The internal same-repository command/SQL boundary has no relevant independently deployed consumer/provider contract. No broker reprobe, package installation or fabricated HTTP endpoint is needed. Framework setup is the appropriate separate workflow if future Playwright/Pact adoption is desired.

coverage_mapping.assertions: Frozen internal preview equals normalized real-save persistence; literal person and microsecond collision window assertions; peer booking and foreign tenant state unchanged.

A signed stale snapshot writes no durable state after a peer commits; actual command performs stale then committed finalization, retains the original command UUID and persists refreshed collision output.

Actual create persists exactly one booking, exact assignees/conflicts, command digest/result and one attributable target-only audit atomically; other assignments, audits and foreign state remain unchanged.

Replacement changes old/new people and windows, removes explicitly peer-owned stale collisions, preserves exact accepted-key evidence on unchanged identity, leaves changed identities open and clears cancellation rows. Every four-booking aggregate participant is independently retrievable; cancellation refresh removes the participant and opens changed identities.

Both create and update at both post-conflict and audit fault stages compare complete booking/assignment/conflict/audit snapshots, including durable private outcomes, against pre-command state; retry proves one successful audit.

invitation expiry after membership and operation-row waits

coverage_mapping.assertions: Registered tests exercise actual commands, writer RPCs and observed pg_blocking_pids barriers. Three stale attempts return SERVER_ERROR with no target/outcome/audit writes; concurrent distinct keys require one refresh and persist the real collision. All eight enrolled writer classes use the first gate before held rows and recheck coherent digests. Replay denies revoked authority and returns authorized historical results without writes. R2 isolates current Auth confirmation/email changes while an operation-row wait is observed and the invitation remains valid for more than 30 minutes, then asserts false result, identical complete membership state, zero added activation audit and exact Auth restoration.

Authenticated/anonymous private calls and direct DML cannot bypass detection; current own-assignment reads and composite tenant/actor authorization remain tested through the Data API and command envelope.
